title: King Charles, Mountbatten and Savile's black berets

tellings.quote:
him and Lord Mountbatton

and uh Jimmy Savile used to all hang out
together

and they all had special black berets
made.

plain: A guest on a podcast, Kurt Metzger, says that King Charles of Britain, Lord Mountbatten, a senior figure in the British royal circle, and Jimmy Savile, a British television presenter, used to hang out together in the 1970s and 80s and all had special black berets made. He tells it in an episode about a supposed secret elite network, as a sign that, if true, these men belonged to some private circle.
